concept.zh: 制图玉米面积上的日最高/最低气温分布
concept.en: Distribution of daily maximum/minimum air temperature over mapped corn area

intendedClaim.zh: 14 天窗口内，按 2023 年制图玉米面积加权的气温描述性统计
intendedClaim.en: Descriptive temperature statistics over the 14-day window, weighted by 2023 mapped corn area

prohibitedClaims.zh: 受影响面积、受影响产量或减产
prohibitedClaims.en: Affected acreage, affected production or yield loss

prohibitedClaims.zh: 作物损害已确认，或未触发即“作物安全/风险低”
prohibitedClaims.en: Confirmed crop damage, or an untriggered screen meaning 'crop safe' / 'low risk'

prohibitedClaims.zh: 局地生育期或某一生育期的暴露
prohibitedClaims.en: Local crop stage or stage-specific exposure

prohibitedClaims.zh: 气温统计即热害
prohibitedClaims.en: Temperature statistics as heat injury

level_c_temperature_summary.proposedMetric: area-weighted mean/min/max/p10/p50/p90 of per-cell 14-day Tmax mean, Tmax maximum, Tmin mean, Tmin minimum
limitations: gridMET is a modeled gridded product, not station truth
2023 crop map is a proxy for current-year planting
level_c_temperature_summary.applicableCropStage: all mapped corn area; stage not resolved (localStageEligibility = insufficient)
level_c_temperature_summary.applicableRegion: ten-state US Corn Belt (Level C scope)
level_c_temperature_summary.spatialSupport: gridMET native cells on cornbelt-iowa-anchored-9km/1, weighted by 2023 native-30m CDL corn area
level_c_temperature_summary.missingnessPolicy: A cell contributes only if all 14 days of every required variable are valid; otherwise its area is reported as missing and never rescaled.
level_c_temperature_summary.denominator: 2023 CDL mapped corn area with valid weather (validWeatherAreaM2)
level_c_temperature_summary.jointExposureAssumption: none; summaries are distributions over mapped area, not joint exposure

heat_extreme_degree_days.proposedMetric: per-cell single-sine EDD summed over 14 days, then area-weighted summary
heat_extreme_degree_days.heuristicComponent: Single-sine reconstruction from daily extremes instead of hourly integration; 14-day window
limitations: Approximation of the diurnal cycle, not hourly data
